title: Countable cover of an open U ⊆ ℝ^N by sets W_p whose r_p-thickenings are ⊂⊂ U (steps 1 and 3)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^N = Euclidean N be open. Then there are sets W_p ⊆ ℝ^N and reals r_p > 0 (p ∈ ℕ) with two properties. First, for every p the open thickening thickening(r_p, W_p) = {y : infEdist(y, W_p) < ofReal(r_p)} is relatively compact open in U (IsRelCompactOpenIn: it is open and its closure is compact and contained in U). Second, U ⊆ ⋃_p W_p.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → ∃ (W : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N)) (r : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ p, 0 < r p) ∧ (∀ p, IsRelCompactOpenIn (thickening (r p) (W p)) U) ∧ U ⊆ ⋃ p, W p
